quotes.text: A segment is a set of people who meet rules you define. It isn't a spreadsheet someone exported six months ago and forgot to update.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A crisp definition that contrasts dynamic segments with static lists.

quotes.text: Before you build anything, answer three simple questions. Who should enter? What should they receive? When should each message arrive?
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A simple checklist for designing any customer journey.

quotes.text: If a record lists the wrong product, an old email address, or a purchase that never happened, the segment pulls in the wrong person, then the message looks careless, even when the journey itself works exactly as planned.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows why data quality decides whether automated marketing feels relevant.

quotes.text: Even a relevant message can become annoying when it arrives too often. Your team should decide how frequently people can hear from you, especially when several journeys might reach the same customer.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A practical recommendation on contact frequency limits.

quotes.text: Keep the first journey small, choose one audience, one clear goal, and one path that your team can explain without a diagram covering an entire wall.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Actionable advice for starting with journeys.

chapters.title: More than a marketing email tool

takeaways: Customer Insights - Journeys plans customer communication as visual journeys that decide who enters, what each person receives and when, based on their actions.
Segments and connected customer profiles only work with clean data and respected consent, channel preferences and contact limits.
Segment-based journeys suit shared schedules, trigger-based journeys respond to customer actions, and Copilot drafts still need human review.
hook: Scattered email lists, sales notes and form entries lead to late, repeated or irrelevant customer messages. This episode explains Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys in plain English for marketing, sales and business teams. You will learn how journeys, segments, channels and triggers work together to send the next sensible message.
